notes.title: Demo update, Feb 2025
notes.notes:
Hello.

There is an updated demo that you can test out. This demo makes various changes and improves different gameplay related things. 

The most obvious change is Moni's new hair. After doing the preview of the new Dolls (Pame and Vero), I realized their hair looked way better than Moni's and Cami's. I decided to go back to those two and improve the hair quality for them too. This is a small change and is purely eye-candy, but I think it's worth it because a lot of work has been put into making the girls attractive, and this improves their overall quality. You can see Moni's new hair below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/63bc956fa135e6cd20ebec899173c61519072135.png[/img]

While Cami is not playable in the demo, she shows up as one of the captured Dolls (context: Dolls become playable as you rescue them in the game). You can see Cami's new look below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/0f5d883ac5167528a59c66e34c0a45bf14c83cd8.png[/img]

On a side-note, it's going to be cool to see Cami next to her twin sister, because, not only they will have different make-up styles, they will have different hair styles.

The HUD has been updated to reflect Moni's change. The HUD also includes pics for Cami and Ceci, but they are not visible since they are not available in the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/364f861fcf33f358c8ecab3d58c65c81706c683f.jpg[/img]

Keys and locked doors can be associated now, because they now have medallions, rather than using a generic model. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/4e54bdfb0ac182815f837769f8d33585e4df96c9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/f32a43ed2da21b82457dab240555d3c1cfbbca61.jpg[/img]

Moni's moves are also updated. She now moves a little bit forward on every slash of her combo, and has two differend "end-attacks" for the combo, a strong slash that causes knock-back, and an uppercut slash that sends her, and the enemy, upwards. She also can perform the air combo, and link the air combo to a stomp attack. 

The stomp is also faster. She is launched down to do the stomp a lot faster than before.

Overall, these changes can open a couple of nice combat tricks. Other Dolls will have a similar style, at least the ones that use a melee weapon. Cami will be different, as she uses the orb, and her combat style is very different to Moni's or any other Doll using a melee weapon.

[previewyoutube=Wr2c8rLtnRE;full][/previewyoutube]

Enemies have also had small AI updates. Health potions and mana potions now heal more points than before. 

Another small update is the "pain states". The demo includes one pain state: the "chest pain state".

You can see two of the pain states in the video below. 

[previewyoutube=4_qf_S7vxr8;full][/previewyoutube]

The first one is a "chest pain" state that usually happens with a boss strong attack, when a Doll is slammed against a wall. This one doesn't really cripple her too much, as she can still jump, but the dash is limited. The second one is a "lower-belly pain" state that happens when the Doll is targeted on her lower-belly area, and this type of attack disrupts her magical link to the weapon, so she can't perform magic attacks, and she can't jump, but still has a limited dash. There's a third pain state, which doesn't show up here, and acts like the lower-belly pain state, and I'll leave it to you to guess what it is. 

Time for some quick lore. I don't know if this has been explained here before or only on X and Patreon, but, in any case, I am explaining again. The weapons used by the Dolls are called "Nishumas" and are made with some "magical obsidian." Only women can use the magical properties of the weapons, because the weapons detect a woman's life-giving power (fancy way of saying "ability to give birth"), and then link to that power. A Nishuma will never react when grabbed by a man, and will never unleash magical attacks when used by a man (it can still be used as a blunt weapon, though). That's the in-game lore explanation for having only female warriors. The actual reason is that we wanted a game with pretty girls fighting monsters, and we came up with some "explanation" for that.

So we came up with this idea of attacks that target a Doll's lower abdomen and pelvic area as a way to disrupt their "magical link" to their weapons. The first idea was that "magic drain attack" seen in the trailer (the purple demon sucking energy out of Cami's lower abdomen) and then evolved from there to make more physical attacks. This includes the magical spells and also the "cool finishers".

And lastly, there's some minor changes in the demo level, mostly related to areas where you have to fight enemies in tiny platforms. Enemies in those tiny platforms were removed.

notes.title: Various updates: new Dolls, game taking a dark turn, and new demo soon-ish
notes.notes:
Hello everybody.

There's been a few new development updates in Killer Dolls Dark Abyss, in various areas, and I wanted to share them with you.

I made some more work on the enemy AI to make them react to the traps better. In a previous demo update, traps could damage enemies. Now, if enemies are hit by a trap, they will move away from it. Overall, enemies avoid walking into traps, but there's always the chance they come in contact with one, so with this update they will get away from the traps if they are hit by them.

This will make it into a demo update soon-ish.

In the previous update I hinted about some enemies and attack types that can deplete or completely wipe out a Doll's magic bar. I explained the reasons for that, and I showed a video. Now I have an updated video that shows the full idea.

[previewyoutube=BZnSYYV5QY4;full][/previewyoutube]

In the video you can see a few things: her magic goes down. There's some pink particle effect around her lower belly, that is somewhat reminiscent of the "magic sucking attack" you see near the end of the trailer (four-ear purple demon sucking the energy from the Doll's belly). When she recovers, she goes into a "pain state" that shows in her idle, walk and run animations. Actually this "pain state" will also affect gameplay.

When in "pain state" she still moves at the same speed and she can still attack, but she can barely dash, she cannot jump, and she cannot use magic attacks (blood-stone spells and special moves/executions). Some gameplay aspects stay the same because it would feel too penalizing if she is crippled too much with these attacks. Still not sure if the dash is reduced too much, so we will have to test that. Another idea I was debating is whether or not magic attacks should just be disabled or if we should put an animation that shows she's unable to perform them (like some kind of "pain reaction" for trying to do the attack). 

I think this will need an additional tutorial to explain the effects of that kind of attack, so players know why certain things don't work if they are attacked that way.

You won't be able to experience this in the demo because these enemies don't show up here. However, if you want to test that out, maybe I could add some "demo-only room" in the demo level with a special type of enemy that performs a similar attack so you can test the "pain state" mechanic and discuss what adjustments it may need.

And now, time for an even darker update. The caves/mines enemy is fully functional now. The boss has some really disturbing and sinister detail that I added after discussing it with a couple of people. It's very disturbing, but I think that's what makes it cool. This was actually inspired by the "Labyrinth Madman" enemy from Bloodborne, which you can see [url=https://www.bloodborne-wiki.com/2024/08/labyrinth-madman-corpse-gallery.html]here[/url].

The caves/mines enemy has a top-level Doll apprentice (known as "Little Chicks" in the game and also the demo) tied up to his improvised mace. There's a catch, though. The girl is alive. You can see the boss and his peculiar mace in the images below. Moni added for size reference.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/0705a9a995d027e68897e1c8f5f4832b31ae8ef3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/ad1e400a334bd3d597fe135b80094ae936b5fac9.png[/img]

The mace has some shards of magical obsidian embeded to it (the same one used for the "Nishumas"), and one of them is slightly piercing her lower belly. This gives him "magical abilities" that he can use during the battle. You can see some of his moves in the video below.

[previewyoutube=Oy0USAT7lZg;full][/previewyoutube]

You can see that, whenever he hits with his mace, a purple aura surrounds it. The idea is that magic is pulled out of the girl and transmitted to the obsidian shards every time she experiences pain. You can also see her react to the hits and hear her tiny screams when the mace hits something, which makes the whole thing even darker.

As you know, Killer Dolls Dark Abyss is self-published. Originally, I wanted to get a publisher and funding, but that didn't work. However, maybe it's for the best. One of the nice things of making a self-published game is that it can have a lot of different things that would be forced out of the game by a publisher. Something tells me the things you see in this update would not be allowed by a publisher, and some of the other stuff I will show in the future would also not be allowed. Not to mention publishers would (and the ones I spoke to actually did) complain about the designs of the girls.

On this same subject, someone on YouTube asked if KDDA will make it to consoles. The plan is to port this to PlayStation, but will only be released if it's allowed "as is", meaning sexy outfits and dark elements. 

And now I think it's time for a more pleasant update. In the post about Moni's outfit redesign I mentioned Moni's red hair in previous versions of the demo was a bug, not a deliberate choice, so her hair was changed to brown, which was her intended hair color. But, to compensate for the change, the game would feature a red-haired Doll. I was playing around with the character design program and made the red-haired Doll. Her name is Vero (Veronica), and she's hot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/52fd88d88ae53137c81eceec4448ee139711c06b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/0a5a5a3f1e0411ab9394168bf853b4bb0ad6835e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/db89def0255c83e58529a8896c0fb0c5df579e77.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/6741ed761dee7546671b9126f5795b49c4c3d641.jpg[/img]

I still don't know what her outfit will look like (she's just wearing a generic leotard used as base for the "festive costume" outfit), and I don't know what weapon she will use. I also have two more Dolls, and I wanted to share them with you:

Additionally, I am happy to show you the next two Dolls that will, eventually, make it into Killer Dolls Dark Abyss.

This is Pame (Pamela), The Feathered Serpent. Just like Vero, she still has no outfit and this leotard is a generic leotard. I already have her outfit design, though. It was designed by a girl working on the game a few months ago. She's going to be the shortest Doll, with barely 155 cm of height. She's also the "small boobs but big butt" Doll of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/dd42511249d33d38d67f0460346693fc4e576e1c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/e1d575d2082b9bc7b3fbd92026cdcb34e5e5bc24.jpg[/img]

And this is Vale (Valeria), The Daughter of The Moon and Cami's twin sister. I don't have the outfit design yet, but I have a solid idea of what it will be. Since she's Cami's twin sister, and Cami is The Daughter of The Sun (hence the red/pink costume), Vale's outfit will be similar to Cami's but with dark-blue and black colors. She's virtually identical to Cami, but the shape of her eyes is slightly different, and she will also have slightly different (bigger) body proportions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/e1318ce88c0c8fcc9ba0ec003511d7cc5638edcf.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/5cd3681d9c69f074c4380bd3fde5e6af53dcef32.jpg[/img]

And that's all for this time. Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.

If you like what you see, and you like the idea of a game about cute girls fighting monsters, please wishlist Killer Dolls Dark Abyss!

Also, this game has a [url=https://patreon.com/thedomaginarium]patreon[/url]. Joining the patreon is free, since there's no rewards at the moment, and there's only a few subscribers, but you have the option to donate in case you want to support the development.

notes.title: Merry (belated) Christmas, happy new year, latest updates.
notes.notes:
Hello.

It's been a while since the last update, but Killer Dolls Dark Abyss is still alive, and there's a few updates. This is going to be a long one!

Ceci, The Jaguar, has gone through some upgrades. Here's a picture that shows a before and after. I think she looks better than before.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/a63d1fc9db1d0afcb61390653ab66ac66fc68258.jpg[/img]

There's been more work on the levels. Updates are mostly for the forest level, but the new caves/mines level has also seen some changes. The idea is that this level also has some ruins of "the old world" (since this is some sort of post-apocalyptic game), so one of the pictures shows a building, that will soon be dirtied and ruined a little. Here's some pictures of the forest level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/a3ede3ade4d48275f91f6a6b846ec6dfbcd52224.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/a0f0b8b90008040514317f64cabcf6dab6297342.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/7f0da682d7f15a87fd3c2a9e82f8899ff6b29b16.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/ded9c25c12fa6073a410c94b49a1df902b24c518.png[/img]

There's been some new enemies as well. These are enemies that will show in the mines/caves level. In the story, they are very violent and brutal, and they have some really brutal attacks. This video shows some of them.

[previewyoutube=hQo15LPFeyo;full][/previewyoutube]

You can see some of these attacks deplete the Doll's magic. There's a reason for that, so it's time for some quick lore. In Killer Dolls lore, the weapons used by the Dolls (called "Nishumas") can only be used by women because the obsidian used to make the weapons "connects" or "reacts" to the women's capacity to give birth and then use this linked energy to unleash magic attacks. This means the Doll don't have magical power themselves, as the magical power comes from their weapons. Some enemies know that, and some of their attacks target the Doll's lower abdomen area to target their ability to use magic (in the game this translates into reducing or completely wiping the Doll's magic bar). 

There's more lore related to this subject, but that's the basic idea.

The caves/mines level is somewhere in the middle of the game, and later levels will have enemies that exploit this vulnerability a lot, including a very vicious boss that will make sure you are barely able to use your magic. This should make combat more interesting and difficult.

This lore bit also partially explains why there's only playable women in the game (the real reason was because we wanted a game with cute girls, but we came up with a lore reason for a female-only group of warriors).

Another update is a small change in Moni's outfit, specifically, the arm and leg bands. So far, two of the three Dolls have a nickname: Cami, (Camila) is The Daughter of The Sun, and Ceci (Cecilia) is The Jaguar), and planned Dolls also have a nickname (for example Cami's twin sister, Vale, Valeria, will be The Daughter of The Moon). That made me think Moni doesn't have a nickname so after a while, I came up with a change to the outfit that could give her a nickname. 

Now she's going to be Moni (Monica), The Jade Princess as she now has jade bracelets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/8154b7ee6abef5387dde7ee6d04afe803a49fdad.png[/img]

The rest of the time has gone into setting up new enemies and fixing enemies and gameplay stuff. For example, these are the zombies that will show up in the forest level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/7eab6425f251495591c03fb02f7cbe70fa1388be.png[/img]

One of the zombies has a staff with a horse skull at the top. This enemy can produce a very interesting attack that also depletes magic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/f571e98da7a1f521132b1baa7f5a2a19ceb7fac2.png[/img]

The horse skull staff is related to another enemy, the woman that "controls" the zombie men.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/84cbf1d645b743912b34ab9573dc9847ab2342b8.png[/img]

According to the lore, this enemy is a "Siguanaba" and is based on a local legend from our country, El Salvador. In the legend, this beautiful woman shows up at night to attract men and, when they are close, she turns into this monster with a horse face and drives men mad. We adapted this legend into the idea of having this "Siguanaba" enemy that has brainwashed men, but they have been under her control for so many years they have turned into living corpses (meaning that they biologically died but she is still controlling them).

I think that's all the updates for this time.

If you like what you see, and you like the idea of a game about cute girls fighting monsters, please wishlist Killer Dolls Dark Abyss!

notes.title: Small weird behavior on some enemies + Moni's new outfit
notes.notes:
While working on the game, some weird behavior was found in some enemies after this last updated. The idea for the enemies was to be at a distance and then move forward to the player and attack, but the behavior now was that the enemy moved forward and attacked at the same time, causing an undesired result. There is a fix now that should fix that issue.

Since the engine already had Moni's new outfit, this new demo update includes the outfit, because there was no reason to keep it from you. You will notice Moni's hair is now brown, not "red-ish". Moni was never meant to be redhead in this game, and it was more like a visual bug we could never get rid of. However, since redheads are nice, we will add a redhead Doll in the future to compensate.

As always, thanks for the support. If you are new here, and a hack'n'slash with sexy girls sounds cool, please wishlist the game :)

notes.notes:

Hello.

There's a new update of the Killer Dolls Dark Abyss demo. In a post, someone mentioned control remappings were not being assigned on game load, and that they were only assigned after opening and closing the options menu. That issue should now be resolved.

notes.title: New demo update available. Demo release 15
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/b7e3973df358ae435cdcb5ee10d3dabaad97d0d2.png[/img]

Hello.

There's a new demo available now. This demo fixes a few issues and also makes some changes to the enemies. Changes should make the enemies more aggressive but allow for more time to react, or at least that was the plan, lol.

The AI for this game is a little tricky because the Dolls are fast, and it's cool that they are fast. Killer Dolls Dark Abyss is a fast game, so it doesn't make sense to have a slow combat with parries, blocking, and it doesn't make to have enemies that "slowly come to you and prepare to attack" either, like other games. So everything has to work according to the speed of the Dolls. The changes only affect the punching enemies and the bow enemies.

This is specially true for, Cami, The Daughter of The Sun (the silver-haired Doll). She's not only fast but can attack from the distance, and her play style forces you to move around since she attacks with the orb.

Other fixes:

Dash direction should be more responsive now. There was an issue that caused the dash to NOT go in the direction you wanted, if you changed direction abruptly and dashed immediately. Now, dash should always go in the direction you want.

The "undead orc" (the orc that revives) should be finally fixed.

Also, the demo should now support cloud saves. This may not be so relevant for the demo, since it's fairly short, but it's there if you need it. The full game will also have cloud saves.

Also, was thinking about adding attack cues to all the punching enemies attacks (the glowing eyes), but I don't know if that's too much. Will continue testing other ways to deliver the attack anticipation for the punching enemies.

As always, if you have any comments or suggestions, drop them in the comments. Also please share this game with your friends. We hope this game does well enough to make more Killer Dolls games in the future!

notes.title: Quick fix for enemies
notes.notes:
Hello.

There's a quick update that fixes a problem where enemy attacks were not registering (the enemy did a punch, but Moni would not receive damage). Sorry for the inconvenience.

Issues where enemies "revive" or "won't die" should also be fixed now. These issues caused enemies to just not die/disappear after their health was depleted. 

This update also brings Moni's updated special spell behavior. In the demo only one of these is available, but you can still see all of them in the video below:

[previewyoutube=jqkwb6xG_x4;full][/previewyoutube]

There is one cool thing we want to add to the boss battle, and hopefully it makes it to the next update. We are also working on changing the enemy AI of an enemy class and also we wanted to make the finisher easier to trigger by increasing the amount of health you can have before you can perform the finisher (for example, making it so you can perform the finisher if you have 40 health instead of 20, but with the limitation of how much health you can get). 

By the way, we have a Patreon that you can join for free or donate $3 a month. notes.title: Making some game improvements. Also, no longer Early Access
notes.notes:
Hello everybody. First of all, thanks for stopping by and your interest.

There are a few things we would like to share about Killer Dolls Battle Arena. If you had visited this page before, you know this game was described as "Early Access". We have decided we are not going to pursue the Early Access route anymore, and instead we will release the game as a full release. We decided this was a better approach for the kind of game we are making, and is also better for you.

Originally, this game was going to be a top-down game. However, as said in previous updates, we decided to turn it into a third person game. That means we are changing the different models for the traps that you run into. For example, we are changing the model of the spinning blade trap:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/a09ed49b183ad06ce160c0d8591a9d5548fb5325.png[/img]

And also the spikes trap:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/fcf270578dbb10e6ebb4abec03b3fb1e021738af.png[/img]

We are also improving the lighting of the game, to make all the graphics cooler.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/8edded16b2e706e601abf3014d84cc57115ec8cf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/44c8f2a8f4c8e21c431322eaf388c8237eff7268.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/d2893c02090e44162a7b0c8fffe52c94c336c7e9.png[/img]

We are also working on enemies, adding new enemy types and other challenges. With this game, our goal is and has always been to make it very challenging, and enemies play a big part in that, but are not the only obstacle. You will have to overcome chasms and traps  using your moves.

By the way, these screenshots show Camila in one of her unlockable costumes (which is a very cool costume, by the way). The game will include a few unlockable costumes, and the plan is to add more costumes as post-launch updates. Those post-launch updates will be FREE, of course. 

More updates about Killer Dolls coming soon!

This is a quick update to share some massive changes for Killer Dolls Battle Arena. After some "introspection" we have decided to make some big changes to the whole entire game. Killer Dolls Battle Arena is changing from a top-down arena-style game to a third-person "longer-level-format" action game. You can watch this to know more.

notes.title: Boss battle preview
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/fed426888ab543891b82d89dffa365c929af2bbe.jpg[/img]

This is a quick preview of a boss battle we're working on. This boss battle will consist of two different "stages." In the first stage, you fight 3 creatures, each with a different attack style (one two of them have ranged attacks, and the third one is a "tank-style" enemy). I don't want to share spoilers, but I'll say the battle becomes slightly more difficult as your enemies take damage.

The second stage of the boss battle is a huge version of the same horned enemy, with different attacks that take a big portion of the arena! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/bb73a5f4633236d6dc1f1befccbbf656d8efb966.jpg[/img]

This boss battle (and all the other ones, actually) take inspiration from classic games with multi-stage bosses. We're currently testing it and the goal is to make it very challenging. You'll be the judge when the game comes out, and if you find it too easy, well we will have to make it more difficult.

More updates will be coming soon!
